name: Pro Schema Form Renderer
description: Renders form-builder JSON as themed, validated multi-step forms: Ajv-checked schema, zod rules per page, react-querybuilder show/hide and page skipping, async server checks, react-dropzone file fields and debounced partial saves.

examples.title: Demo request with logic and async checks

props.name: schema
props.description: Form JSON from ProFormBuilder or your API; validated with Ajv before rendering (invalid schemas show an error state)

props.name: initialValues
props.description: Prefill or resume values (merged over schema defaults and any stored draft)

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Final submit with hidden-field values stripped; throw to show an error banner

props.name: onSavePartial
props.description: Debounced partial-response save (files serialised as metadata)

props.name: draftKey
props.description: Mirror drafts to localStorage under this key and restore on mount

props.name: asyncValidators
props.description: Server checks referenced by field.asyncValidator; resolve an error message or null

props.name: keepHiddenValues
props.description: Keep values of logic-hidden fields in the payload

props.name: loading
props.description: Show a skeleton while the schema loads

usage: <ProFormRenderer schema={schema} asyncValidators={{ businessEmail }} onSavePartial={saveDraft} onSubmit={(values) => api.submit(values)} />
